Adding technical context from SE side — putting restraints and notes here so CS has a checklist:

1) Integration type: we will provide two endpoints during pilot (sandbox REST + production VPC peered endpoint). Sandbox API keys are fine for early work, production requires per-customer client certs and KMS-wrapped keys.
2) Model artifacts: they requested the open-model variant we benchmarked (redwood-compat-small-v2). For pilot, recommend 2xA100-40GB equivalent serving nodes with autoscale to 4 for peak tests.
3) Token distribution: typical 256 token inputs (~60% of requests), 4% heavy 1024-token requests (for retrieval-augmented queries). This affects batch size and latency.
4) Data flows: no raw PHI should be stored in our hosted logs; we will enable scrubbers and token redaction for their pilot. Need legal to sign off on redaction SLA.

Attached: integration_notes.md (text), and I will paste a short checklist into the CS runbook:
- Sandbox API key created: yes
- Test corpus (50 documents) shared: pending (customer)
- VPC peering template: ready
- Expected latency for 512-token typical load: ~120ms p50 with recommended instance type

If we want, I can join the kickoff to walk through the endpoints and the initial load tests.

—Dev
